items.title: HPA NET Roundtable: AI as a Second Unit
items.excerpt: HPA's October NET Roundtables framed AI as a 'second unit' that works on a defined brief while humans stay in charge; post supervisors agreed retakes are the real cost of an AI shot, that AI is landing first in background removal, uprez and set extensions, and that local AI plus content credentials matter.

items.title: Final Equity-Pact Deal Offer Includes AI Provisions, Streamer Residuals
items.excerpt: UK actors union Equity is taking Pact's final offer for UK TV and film (2027-2029) to its 8,000 members with a 'yes' recommendation; its four-pronged AI section covers digital replicas, digital alteration of performances, 'Synthetics' and AI training licensing.

items.title: French Movie Regulator Won't Fund AI Dubbing and Subtitling
items.excerpt: France's CNC will no longer fund dubbing, subtitling or audio-description projects made without human creators; from Nov. 1 funded films, series, games and animation must involve at least one (graphic) author, though AI tools are not banned outright. [off-list exception: no on-list outlet covered the CNC rule]

items.title: [REVIEW] AI movie 'Raphael' impresses visually, lacks fresh plot
items.excerpt: Korea's first feature made entirely with generative AI, the 138-minute sci-fi 'Raphael' (in theaters Nov. 25), took about 14 months; the review praises consistent characters and lip sync but finds the story overly familiar.

items.title: A Quick Look at How Adobe's New AI Assistant Could Streamline Your Workflows in Premiere
items.excerpt: One of the biggest Adobe MAX 2026 announcements was the new Premiere AI Assistant; No Film School explains what it is and how it works in an editing workflow. (Adobe MAX follow-up - saturated angle)

items.title: Virtual Content Creator Roundtable
items.excerpt: Vendors and creators on how social creators adopt film/episodic workflows; Blackmagic points to a new DaVinci Resolve feature that lets AI assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT Codex build highlight edits, remove clips and render deliverables, while others cite agentic AI for footage organization and rough cuts.

items.title: 경민대, 극장용 AI 애니메이션 제작 산학 협력
items.excerpt: 경민대가 강단스튜디오·스튜디오시네틱스와 협약을 맺고 극장용 AI 성경 뮤지컬 애니메이션 '요나'(2027년 하반기 개봉 목표) 제작에 재학생을 참여시킨다. 스튜디오시네틱스가 AI 기술 파트너를 맡는다. (alt image source: https://www.segye.com/newsView/20261116511244 og https://www.segye.com/content/image/2026/11/16/20261116511185.png)

items.title: [AI와 방송의 동행] 해외 방송가 기술 도입 속도전…제작 패러다임 바뀐다
items.excerpt: 중국 숏폼 AI 콘텐츠의 방송 진출, 일본 지상파의 드라마 전반 생성형 AI 도입 계획, 글로벌 OTT의 AI 활용 확대 등 해외 방송·영상 제작의 AI 도입 흐름을 정리한 기획. [off-list exception; overview piece]

items.title: SAG-AFTRA Boss Says AI Takedowns Matter More Than Damages To Performers
items.excerpt: SAG-AFTRA CEO Duncan Crabtree-Ireland says most performers whose likenesses are misused by AI want the content removed rather than damages. (Web Summit remarks partly covered earlier - weak)

items.title: Adobe Gives Sneak Peek at Real-Time Generative AI Video Editing Feature
items.excerpt: Adobe's Project Live Set sneak lets creators generate and edit video while it plays, in real time. (Adobe MAX sneaks - saturated angle)

items.title: CAA Wants to Create an AI-Generated Celebrity Advertising Machine
items.excerpt: CAA and Ogilvy launched a platform that lets marketers produce AI-generated ads featuring talent-approved celebrity likenesses without hours on set.

items.title: Director Hyun Hae-ri Unveils Live-Action, AI, and VFX Integrated Production Pipeline at Tokyo AI Film Festival
items.excerpt: MooAm showed at AI Film Festival Japan 2026 a pipeline combining live-action shooting, generative AI, VFX and color grading, keeping real footage where it works and using AI only for hard-to-film shots. [off-list exception]

items.title: AI 영화 도전 이명세 "한국영화 몸값 낮춰야 AI 시대 대응할 수 있어"
items.excerpt: '충무로 비주얼 장인' 이명세 감독이 AI 영화 작업에 도전하며 "한국영화 몸값을 낮춰야 AI 시대에 대응할 수 있다"고 말한 인터뷰. [off-list exception; interview]
